english.note: This is the all-purpose term for an intellectual as an educated person who thinks and discusses ideas.
Use this for an intellectual person, especially as a member of the educated or intellectual class.

examples.english: They are an intellectual who often discusses social issues with others。
That person is an intellect who has long cared about social justice.
examples.traditional: 嗰位知識分子長年關心社會公義。
